name: btd6-opendata-site
description: Aggressively cached front-end for the Ninja Kiwi BTD6 Open Data API

scripts.test: node --import ./test/url-imports.ts --test --test-reporter=spec test/worker.test.ts test/store.test.ts test/format.test.ts test/events.test.ts test/rounds.test.ts test/bosses.test.ts test/maps.test.ts test/paragon.test.ts test/suggest.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run validate && npm test
scripts.dev:offline: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply btd6-opendata --local && wrangler dev --local --test-scheduled --var NK_BASE:http://127.0.0.1:8788
scripts.dev: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply btd6-opendata --local && wrangler dev --local --test-scheduled
scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply btd6-opendata --remote && wrangler deploy
